works.title: The Big Awareness: A Cosmology Without a Beginning
works.description: A scientific paper proposing an alternative cosmological model that challenges the Big Bang theory. Argues the universe has always existed in a state of potential awareness as a quantized substrate densely packed at the Planck limit, with the Big Bang as an ignition event rather than creation, driven by matter-antimatter annihilation.
works.quote: Incorporate that idea into the body of the paper.

works.title: Tax Policy Distributional Analysis Reference Reports
works.description: A series of comprehensive reference reports analyzing tax policy in the United States, focusing on distributional incidence analysis. Report 2.1 examines Congressional Budget Office analyses, Joint Committee on Taxation methodologies, and competing approaches to corporate tax incidence across income levels.
works.quote: Produce a comprehensive reference report on the distributional analysis of tax policy in the United States.
